qualitative_review.ambient2-courtyard: The original Follow frames show a visible small group with readable body silhouettes. Copied phases show repeated approach/watch, regroup and three sampled dispersal goal keys. This is the clearest social activity of the three watched selections. The same peer observation can switch approach/watch as distance changes; sampled counts are not a complete transition history or evidence of coordinated planning.
qualitative_review.ambient2-refinery: The original Follow frames make the sealed attraction and adjacent accessible pocket legible. The selected actor repeatedly returns, records failures and withdraws; an accessible second patch receives an inspection phase at sampled37-39s. The loop remains confined and repetitive. Historical target962.5,526.5 is retained while current nearest observations often differ; its current material occupancy is unconfirmed, not inferred from rendered colors. One earlier obstruction record expires by sampled40s before seven further failures accumulate.
qualitative_review.ambient2-settlement: The flyer moves around the visible canopy and support geometry, retains temporary destinations, selects a homeward/rest interval, then resumes its prior exploration goal key5. Local approaches are visibly constrained by the supports. The sampled home-rest interval exposes a real arrival/recharge radius mismatch. The selected body and diagnostic overlay are readable in the original Follow frame; this does not establish hardware playfeel.
